clips.title: The story
paras: "In Favor of the Light" marks a young priest's rite of passage from the isolated training grounds of Coldridge Valley into the wider reaches of Dun Morogh. Instructed by Branstock Khalder, novitiates are sent through the mountain tunnel to Kharanos to further their studies under Priest Trainer Maxan Anvol. It signals that an acolyte is ready to shoulder real responsibilities and earn the traditional vestments of their calling.

In the secluded cradle of Coldridge Valley, dwarven priests begin their studies under the watchful eye of instructors like Branstock Khalder. Once a novice demonstrates sufficient dedication and grasp of Holy magic, their preliminary instruction comes to an end. Rather than keeping them sheltered in Anvilmar, Khalder directs promising students beyond the mountains to Kharanos, where the demands of ministry and defense intersect with the daily struggles of Dun Morogh's folk.

Reaching Kharanos requires trekking through the Coldridge Pass tunnel into the windswept snows of central Dun Morogh. Waiting at the settlement is Maxan Anvol, a senior priest tasked with guiding students beyond rudimentary prayers. Anvol believes firmly that devotion to the Holy Light requires equal measures of moral character, physical hardiness, and an unyielding will. For acolytes who prove their resolve under his tutelage, Anvol prepares to bestow their first formal garments of office.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ya been following the Light now for long enough that you find your way to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos. He'll teach ya more about the path yer following, and if you prove worthy, give ya yer first set of robes to denote your station as a priestess.
Now get goin'! As soon as yer done here, head through the tunnel--he'll be waitin' for ya.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, so Branstock sent ya, did he? Good, good! He's right, it is 'bout time you started taking a much larger step into the Light. It'll build character and make ya stronger... An' that's what you'll need more than anything: strength of body... Strength of will.
